tool.name: Docker Runner
tool.description: Execute any command in a Docker container
tool.command:
#if $command_type.type_selector == "simple" $command_type.command #else ## Custom script execution bash -c '$command_type.script' #end if
#if $input_file --input '$input_file' #end if
#if $output_name > '$output' #else > '$output' #end if

param.name: command
param.label: Command
param.help: Docker command to execute (e.g., samtools view, bwa mem)

tool.help:
**Docker Runner Tool**
This tool executes commands inside the biomate/biotools Docker container. It provides access to all bioinformatics tools available in the unified Docker image.
**Available Tools:** - samtools, bcftools, bedtools - bwa, bowtie2, hisat2, star - fastp, fastqc, multiqc - And many more...
**Usage:** 1. Select command type (simple or script) 2. Enter the command or script to execute 3. Optionally provide an input file 4. Run the tool
**Example Commands:** - ``samtools view -h input.bam`` - ``fastp -i input.fastq -o output.fastq`` - ``bedtools intersect -a file1.bed -b file2.bed``
